overall.note: Quarry, replica, and --replay made M1–M2/M4–M6/M8 plus 167k scale direct; M3 choreography stayed a capability-failure on typing, receipts, and new-member live (final-report).

setup_and_docs.note: README plus guide cards (feeds, expire, assets, personas) got M1 compiling on first check; guide presence omits the open-chat⇒peer-observes-read recipe (diary M3).

data_modeling.note: likeCount, unique likes, expire at, once, following-as-activity, and the digest job compiled on the first snapback4 check (diary M1–M2, schema.q).

authorization.note: Password identity, HANDLE_TAKEN, and membership rules (exists memberships, cap 50, admin add) mapped Clique boundaries without a second policy language (schema.q, essay).

queries_and_live.note: usePage live DMs and M8 dual-device greened; typing/delivered/new-member missed harness windows; membersOf invalidation and connected[p] false for HTTP (M3 capability-failure).

writes_and_transactions.note: Set-state likes/reposts/reactions as unique if-absent intents; edit/delete require server now; fixture mutation ids produced E_WRITE_ID (agent, why).

offline_sync.note: Replica and queued writes are productized; M6 in-order flush and M8 dual-offline greened without an app outbox (diary M6/M8, essay).

media_assets.note: client.upload, typed image/video columns, duration sniffing, and once-on-fetch matched M4/M5 choreography (guide assets, diary M4–M5).

background_work.note: expire at, effect notify/digestPush, job digest, schedule digestEvery every 2m; worker.mjs is the push seam; --replay holds schedules (schema.q).

client_integration.note: snapback4-expo createApp, session restore, and usePage are the paved template; web replica presence and membersOf catch-up needed polling (src/client.ts, M3).

diagnostics_dev_loop.note: check plus why codes (HANDLE_TAKEN, E_WRITE_ID) were sharp; live watermark invalidation stayed opaque (ambiguous membersOf, B10).

scale_and_limits.note: Isolated --replay settled 167157 actions with 0 failures; sql counts matched the combined invariant manifest exactly (scale-replay-receipt, 1258s).

operations.note: snapback4 sql/data/dev --replay, isolated scale store, and wipe-after-E_WRITE_ID; schema adds required a process restart (final-report B11).

snapback4.verdict: A sync-set backend that made schema, expiry, offline, and scale feel native, then lost the WhatsApp live-receipts bar.
snapback4.would_use_again_for: Offline-first social apps whose source of truth is a membership partition with expiry, not Playwright-tight presence.

overall.note: Only this lane greened M1–M6+M8 choreography via useQuery; it paid with hand-rolled bcrypt/outbox, queries that do not tick, and unfinished 32k-limited scale.

setup_and_docs.note: Anonymous local mode bound 55501/55502 without an account; --local-cloud-port is hideHelp() and a second instance’s copied admin key 401’d (diary M1/M6).

data_modeling.note: TypeScript tables and colocated indexes were low-cost; receipts, search tokens, and insights counters were extra tables plus write-time bumps (schema.ts, essay).

authorization.note: No product session: bcrypt plus a sessions table, token on every verb, membership checks inside handlers (auth.ts, essay).

queries_and_live.note: useQuery greened M1–M3/M8 two-client live without a channel API; queries do not re-run on Date.now(), so typing/expiry used client timers (diary M3/M5).

writes_and_transactions.note: Mutations plus clientId idempotency were enough; optional validators reject null (mediaStorageId:null silent-fail, convex-defect knowledge-gap, run-log 1789584990).

offline_sync.note: No outbox; a localStorage queue greened M6 flush and M8 dual-offline on web (src/offline.ts, diary M6). Native relaunch not-run (environment).

media_assets.note: generateUploadUrl → POST → storage.getUrl covered avatars/posts/backgrounds without bucket policy; view-once is an app table and getUrl can be null (essay, media.ts).

background_work.note: crons.interval digest-emit plus isReplayMode skipped 100k side effects; scheduled writes are first-class, query clocks are not (crons.ts, diary M8).

client_integration.note: ConvexProvider/useQuery made Expo web a live projection; the custom client is ConvexHttpClient/anyApi, not REST; Metro stale bundles were Expo (essay).

diagnostics_dev_loop.note: Function reload ~300ms; null-vs-undefined failed silently in the UI; collect() ‘Many documents read’ at 32k was the scale diagnostic (run-log, essay).

scale_and_limits.note: A fresh anonymous sqlite instance was cheap; the 32k-document read limit (convex-defect) forced paged counts; invariant verification stayed PENDING (final-report, runtime.ts).

operations.note: One default anonymous-agent name; cloning needed a new directory and generated secret (BadAdminKey); seed is the mutation firehose (diary M6).

convex.verdict: The live two-client messenger backend, with honest online-shaped clients and a hard document-read ceiling at this envelope.
convex.would_use_again_for: Two-client reactive messengers where you will hand-roll auth, an outbox, and write-time counters.

overall.note: Auth and SQL invariants paid rent; Realtime/offline/jobs were a BFF plus polls, M3 aborted, M4–M8 blocked-by-M3, and scale stopped before 10% (final-report).

setup_and_docs.note: Hosted Auth/Storage docs got M1 green; no CLI/local stack, Realtime enabled by ALTER PUBLICATION, email_confirm forced (diary M1, essay).

data_modeling.note: UNIQUE handle, dm_pair, CHECKs, and now() expressed Clique invariants directly; the server program is 1643-line store.mjs, not policies (schema.mjs, essay).

authorization.note: Supabase Auth is the password path; row rules lived in a service-role BFF because RLS for windows/digest/push felt heavier than a store function (essay).

queries_and_live.note: No live query used: 1s feeds, 700ms messages, 200ms typing polls; Realtime under-used; M3 typing-in-2s and live bubbles never greened (diary M3, ConversationScreen).

writes_and_transactions.note: Postgres constraints plus mutation_id uniqueness and now() windows; replay drives the same store functions (schema.mjs, essay). The $1 type error was agent-error.

offline_sync.note: supabase-js 2.112.4 has no brief-matching outbox; a localStorage queue exists, M6 suite passed, web offline choreography never greened (diary M6, essay).

media_assets.note: Private bucket plus authorizeMedia streaming made revocation obvious rather than a signed-URL cache; M4 suite green, choreography blocked-by-M3 (essay, store.mjs).

background_work.note: Digest is setInterval in the API process, not pg_cron (no CLI); push_log when no fresh device (server/index.mjs, diary M8).

client_integration.note: supabase-js persistSession plus a homegrown HTTP API; session-restore 401s and polls instead of hooks (CliqueProvider, correction loop 8).

diagnostics_dev_loop.note: SQL errors were usable; Auth wrapped handle collision as ‘Database error creating new user’; EMAXCONNSESSION appeared under parallel suite+choreo (final-report).

scale_and_limits.note: Fresh clq916g_s_ starter settled; scale.log stopped before the 10% checkpoint; hosted pooler max clients bit M8 (scale-replay.json, EMAXCONNSESSION).

operations.note: Prefix drop cleaned 48 table/function/bucket objects; Auth users are not prefix-namespaced and remained in the shared hosted project (cleanup, final-report).

supabase.verdict: A hosted Postgres/Auth kit that forces a BFF for Clique’s session-shaped live, offline, and job work.
supabase.would_use_again_for: Constraint-heavy social graphs and password Auth, if you will own Realtime, a worker, and the client outbox.

cross_backend_notes: M3 two-client live split the lanes: Convex useQuery greened typing/receipts/DMs; Snapback’s watermark plus connected[p] plus chatFocus stack never stayed inside harness windows; Supabase polled at 200/700ms and aborted.
Offline was Snapback’s replica product; Convex and Supabase both shipped localStorage queues, and only Convex greened M6/M8 web offline choreography.

Scale: Snapback --replay matched 167157 actions to the invariant manifest; Convex hit a 32k document-read ceiling and left verification PENDING; Supabase never reached the 10% checkpoint on the hosted pooler.
Auth identity was Snapback use-identity-password with named HANDLE_TAKEN, Supabase Auth as a second namespace from profiles, and Convex bcrypt inside a mutation with a token on every verb.
Declarative engine features decided M5/M8 labor: Snapback expire/once/count/jobs, Convex crons.interval, Supabase setInterval in the API process.
